name: Lantern Light
hint: Lights out! Whoever holds the lantern lights the way for everyone.
why4: The block is marked 4 and fills the tunnel; it only moves with all four pushing in a line.
solution: P4 (in front) picks up the lantern at x=7 (Grab) and leads; everyone jumps the 2-wide pit at x=10-11.

P3 stands under the one-way shelf at x=16; P2 jumps onto P3's head and up through the shelf (height 3), touches the key at x=16 and drops back down. The lantern carrier can't take the key: the key only jumps into empty hands.
Everyone jumps the 2-wide pit at x=20-21.
Line up in the tunnel: P4 against the block (x=27), P2, P3, P1 behind; all hold Right.
Push until the block drops into the hole at x=33-35; jump over it.
P2 (key) opens the door at x=45; all press Down.
Recovery: a lantern dropped in a pit returns to x=7.
